annotations.title: Get the full text of a Journal Officiel act

description: Get the full text of one act of the Algerian Journal Officiel published since 1962, by its number (for example 22-299, with type when a law and a decree share the number) or by year, issue and ord as search_jo_text returns them. Returns its type, number, title, first page, the links to the issue page and the official PDF, the text itself in parts of 20,000 characters (part, parts, chars: ask the next part to read on), and named_in_titles: the earlier or later acts whose title names this one, such as the decrees amending or completing it, its corrigenda and its implementing texts. Check named_in_titles before quoting an article: the text is the one published in that issue, not a consolidated version. For 1962 to 2001 (source scan) the text was read from the scan: a passage between [[? and ?]] is not settled yet (uncertain counts them), check it on pdf_url before quoting it; the page is the page of the scan. Without an API key, only the acts of the current year and the two before it. Algeria only (country DZ); other countries return country_not_available.

country.description: Country of the data, an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code in any letter case: DZ for Algeria, the default, TN for Tunisia or MA for Morocco. Only live countries answer: list_countries shows them and their datasets. Any other country, or a dataset the country does not have (for example the activity nomenclature for Morocco), returns country_not_available. Without an API key only DZ answers: TN and MA return key_required.

issue.description: The number of the issue within its year, as search_jo_text returns it.

lang.description: Language of the labels, notes and attribution text in the answer: fr (French, the default), ar (Arabic) or en (English).

number.description: The number of the act as the Journal Officiel prints it, for example 22-299 or 26-06.

ord.description: The place of the act in its issue, as search_jo_text returns it.

part.description: Which part of the text, 1 by default; parts says how many there are.

type.description: The kind of act, needed when several acts carry the number (a law and a decree, for example).

year.description: The year of the issue (with issue and ord), or to narrow a number.

name: get_jo_act
title: Get the full text of a Journal Officiel act
